    01 — About

    Profile

    I'm Allyssa Geanne Quinit, an Information Technology graduate with experience in UI/UX design, manual QA, and product documentation — currently seeking a junior role where I can keep learning and help build user-centered digital products.

    I design user-centered interfaces, document software issues, and create clear documentation for team collaboration. Detail-oriented, adaptable, and curious about the whole product lifecycle — from planning and design to testing and delivery.

    Location Pampanga, Philippines
    Education BS Information Technology · PSU
    Languages English · Filipino

    02 — Experience

    Where I've worked

    Two internships at the same company — first in UI/UX design, then a cross-functional role covering manual QA, business analysis, and project management.

    QA · Business Analysis · Project Management Complete

    Mar 2026 — Jul 2026

    Second Internship · Twala (Ohelio, Inc.) · Manila, Philippines

    Cross-functional internship

    • Quality Assurance — Ran manual tests on Doxu.AI's mobile responsiveness and filed detailed bug tickets; tested landing pages across web and mobile for functionality and layout consistency.
    • Business Analysis — Built competitive comparison matrices for TwalaSign, developed feature backlogs for TwalaSign and Doxu.AI, and drafted product documentation. Completed a Udemy Business Analysis course alongside the work.
    • Project Management — Monitored mobile-responsiveness tasks for Doxu.AI (Twala v2), tracking progress and status. Completed a Udemy Project Management course covering planning, scoping, and delivery.

    UI/UX Designer Complete

    Feb 2025 — May 2025

    First Internship · Twala (Ohelio, Inc.) · Manila, Philippines

    Design internship

    • Redesigned selected landing pages for clarity and layout, implementing updates directly in Webflow — including the client and partner carousel.
    • Helped restructure Twala's help center articles in Intercom so users could find what they needed.
